title: [2026-10-09] feat: replace Qwen3-TTS Instruct Flash with Qwen-Audio 3.0 TTS Flash
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Replaced Qwen3-TTS Instruct Flash with the paid-only qwen/qwen-audio-3.0-tts-flash ahead of Alibaba's retirement of the old model on 2026-10-10 at 00:00 UTC+8. The new model uses the same DashScope account and key, has a 1× multiplier, is billed per 10,000 characters, and offers 12 Chinese/English system voices; base voice names also pass through. The former canonical ID and three short IDs remain aliases, so existing model selections and category-based key permissions need no migration. Qwen TTS handling now uses per-model configuration for endpoints, voice mapping, and instruction support; the new model calls /services/audio/tts/SpeechSynthesizer with parameters.instruction. OpenAI voice names map to supported voices, including alloy → loongeva_v3.6, echo/onyx → loongjohn, and fable/shimmer → loongmary. Other voice names pass through, and Alibaba returns a 400 for unknown names. The new Alibaba billing label is mapped; usage counts input characters, with CJK characters counted twice. Local checks covered both /v1/audio/speech and GET /audio/{text}, legacy aliases, WAV responses, and repeat-request caching.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art recording nook, Polli wears tiny headphones and helps a friendly CRT monitor robot tend twelve little voice-flower pots beside a lime green (#ecf874) soundboard, with soft mint-to-peach gradients and warm cream walls. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium within the scene, never oversized, and strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, chunky sprites, subtle CRT glow, and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
